scope: Nine key stages around current Macro source and recent context studies; source/archive code and recorded optimizer schedules, plus manual objective/gradient route review. Earlier studies are not cleared by this audit.

findings.finding: Only remote ages17+ receive the additional structure loss; local diagnostic head is detached from encoder in multiple stages. Not an implementation accident, but cannot be described as a symmetric near/far encoder objective.
Changing prefix availability changes band averaging; full-context training mixes added input history, expanded labels and changed effective age weights. It does not isolate input length alone.

Context Transfer resets optimizer and uses fixed peak LR immediately. Earlier audited warm stages have warmup/cosine; optimizer reset alone is not automatically invalid when matched across arms. No evidence here establishes high LR as the unique cause.

Shared History free auxiliary task admits query-independent noncollapsed solutions. The existing constructive counterexample limits semantic claims, not proof that real trained weights used that shortcut.
Depth equal100 comparisons retain recipe-level evidence; extended4-layer191/281 add updates, exposure, LR restarts and validation opportunities. Cannot infer4layers globally optimal.

Repeated research cohorts, warm starts, epoch0 fallbacks and decoder/encoder co-adaptation limit generalization and information-loss claims. Report arithmetic verification does not establish causal interpretation or independent replication.

Stable continuation control and source/new first-step behavior with exact optimizer/sampling contract
Re-evaluation plan using fresh independent holdout after model/design freeze, rather than repeated research-set selection
